title: Insider One - AI-powered omnichannel growth management platform
clean_text: Insider One, formerly the Insider Growth Management Platform, is an AI-powered customer engagement platform integrating a Customer Data Platform (CDP), personalization, and journey orchestration across WhatsApp, SMS, email, web, app, and site search. The Smart Recommender module delivers AI-driven product recommendations as part of the broader suite. Unifies data from 100+ sources into real-time customer profiles. Targets large enterprises with complex omnichannel requirements, mature data infrastructure, and dedicated technical teams, serving over 2,000 customers including Samsung, L'Oreal, and Unilever.
